And we are very grateful to Poland that, at such a difficult time, we are receiving the help we need," Zelenskyy said in a statement on US social media platform X. He said he also briefed Tusk on preparations for possible trilateral technical-level meetings between Ukraine, the US and Russia. "There are no obstacles on our side, but it is important that the American side prepare on its end and ensure Russia’s readiness," Zelenskyy said. "Not everything can be discussed in detail over the phone, so we agreed to meet in person in the near future," he added.
